t: Every creature that does not keep a savings account
a: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
p: Wa ka-ayyin min dābbatin lā taḥmilu rizqahā, Allāhu yarzuquhā wa iyyākum…
m: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allāh provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
